## Ingredients

- 1¼ lb ground turkey, 93/7
- 1 can black beans, drained and rinsed
- 1 can kidney beans, drained and rinsed
- 1 (14.5-ounce) can diced tomatoes
- 2 tablespoons tomato paste
- 1 yellow onion, diced
- 2 jalapeños, diced
- 1 bell pepper, diced
- 3 cloves garlic, minced
- 1 tablespoon chili powder
- 2 teaspoons cumin
- 1 teaspoon smoked paprika
- Salt, to taste

## Instructions

1. Brown the turkey in a pot with a little oil, breaking it up as it cooks. Salt.
2. Add onion, jalapeños, bell pepper, and garlic. Cook about 5 minutes until soft.
3. Stir in the spices and tomato paste and cook 1 minute.
4. Add diced tomatoes, both beans, and about 1 cup water. Simmer 25–30 minutes.
5. Serve. Cool the rest and refrigerate or freeze in portions.

## Notes

- Make the full pot. It covers dinner plus a fallback dinner or extra lunch later in the week.
- One serving lands around 45–55 g protein plus fiber.
